transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I've called this roundtable together as part of our pre-event planning policy before I release the Furnace 2 schedule for tonight's demand-response window. We have two pending heat-treatment orders — Order Delta for alloy housings and Order Echo for actuator rings — and Furnace 2 is available for one overnight load between 18:00 and 06:00. Before I make the binding decision on which order to schedule, I need to check with each of you: Quality, do you have any concerns or constraints regarding either order? Utilities, is there anything about the demand-response window, the maximum load, or the required cool-down period I need to factor in? And Warehouse Logistics, are there any material availability or shipping considerations for either order? I want to hear from all of you before I finalize the schedule.

I reviewed the Furnace 2 qualification log this afternoon, and the current Furnace 2 recipe is approved for Order Delta but NOT for Order Echo. Running Echo would require a separate 4-hour recipe requalification before it could proceed. Also, the qualification log requires exactly 6 witness coupons for an approved Order Delta run. The qualification result hasn't been entered on the production board yet, so this wouldn't have been visible to anyone else.
